scripts.gen: go tool github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen -generate types -o internal/api/types.gen.go -package api api/openapi.yaml && go tool github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen -generate spec -o internal/api/spec.gen.go -package api api/openapi.yaml && go tool github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen -generate std-http,strict-server -o internal/api/server.gen.go -package api api/openapi.yaml
scripts.build: go run github.com/syumai/workers/cmd/workers-assets-gen -mode=go && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o ./build/app.wasm .
